# Code Anchors: Scratch Capture

- `CLAUDE.md` — the standing decision-stub authoring rule: the committed per-user path, issue-only epic-number resolution (no queue-entry or directory match), and the branch-keyed append-only filenames.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — seeds the committed-scratch convention, the issue-only resolution rule, and retires the plan-capture hook and its opt-in registration.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — mines the committed per-user stubs as hints verified against the diff and retains them (no deletion).
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — reads the committed scratch as soft context that never changes a verdict.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — records the boundary: the distiller never reads the per-user scratch into a concept, and re-aims an ephemeral entry's committed removal at this directory.
